claim: Intro: Connect IQ is a different program from the cloud APIs, and one does not require the other.
quote: No, the Garmin Connect Developer Program APIs and the Connect IQ programs are different programs. One does not require the use of the other.

claim: Intro / FAQ: Connect IQ has a free SDK for watch faces, data fields, widgets and apps.
quote: I see the Connect IQ developer program allows for the creation of watch faces, data fields, widgets and applications.

claim: Intro / FAQ: Connect IQ's SDK is free.
quote: Learn more about Connect IQ and start using our free SDK.

claim: Answer / access: the program supports a broad range of organizations.
quote: The Garmin Connect Developer Program supports a broad range of organizations, from individual developers and startups to companies operating at significant scale.

claim: Access table: Starter Access wording.
quote: Starter Access: Developers can gain immediate access and launch with Garmin, with access to core data and tools.

claim: Access table: Enterprise Access is for companies operating at scale, with expanded data access, reliability and enterprise-grade support.
quote: Enterprise Access: For companies operating at scale, this new model aligns with growth, offering expanded data access, reliability, and enterprise-grade support.

claim: Access table: Starter lists the Activity, Courses, Health, Training and Women's Health APIs (Starter card).
quote: The starting point for organizations building apps with Garmin Connect API access. Build, test, and launch integrations using core Garmin Connect APIs.

claim: Access table / delivery / rate limits: Starter is push only, with no historical data and limited user capacity.
quote: Push only Historical Data Not included User Capacity Limited

claim: Access table / five APIs / rate limits: Enterprise adds a Golf API, push or ping/pull, a month or more of history, unlimited user capacity and technical support.
quote: Golf API JSON Delivery Push or Ping/Pull Historical Data 1 month + User Capacity Unlimited Technical Support Included

claim: Access table / fees: Enterprise commercial terms are tailored.
quote: Designed for companies operating at scale requiring capabilities beyond Starter Access. Available options and commercial terms are tailored based on business and technical requirements.

claim: Access: create an app with Starter Access and request Enterprise Access through the Developer Portal as needs grow.
quote: Apply for the Garmin Connect Developer Program and create an app with Starter Access. As your business and integration needs evolve, you can request Enterprise Access through Garmin Developer Portal.

claim: Access / FAQ / steps: once approved you get the Garmin Developer Portal and can start right away.
quote: After you request access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program and your request has been approved, you will be granted access to the Garmin Developer Portal and can get started on your integration right away.

claim: Access / auth / steps: detailed documentation is in the Developer Portal.
quote: All detailed technical information and documentation is available within the Garmin Developer Portal.

claim: Answer / access / FAQ / steps: a typical integration takes between 1 and 4 weeks.
quote: A typical integration takes between 1 and 4 weeks.

claim: Access: the Health API page adds an evaluation environment for testing after approval.
quote: After approval, you will have access to an evaluation environment to test the Garmin Connect Health API.

claim: Access / what changed: until October 2026 the FAQ promised a decision within two business days and an integration call (Wayback Machine capture of October 17, 2026).
quote: After you request the Garmin Connect Developer Program, we will confirm the status of your application within two business days.

claim: What changed: the integration call and the Stay tuned banner on the October 17 FAQ capture.
quote: In parallel, we will invite you to an integration call to help understand your needs and walk you through the high-level technical details of the Developer Program and its APIs.

claim: What changed: the banner on the October 17 FAQ capture.
quote: Stay tuned for more updates on the program

claim: What changed / fees: the former business-use-only and no-licensing-fee sentence (October 17 capture).
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use. Access to some metrics may require a license fee payment or minimum device order quantity for commercial use.

claim: Five APIs: you can use any or all APIs in a single application.
quote: Yes, you may utilize any or all APIs in a single application (Health, Activity, Women's Health, Training and Courses).

claim: Five APIs: the Health API covers all-day metrics such as steps, heart rate, sleep and stress, for corporate wellness, population health and patient monitoring.
quote: The Health API enables you to leverage valuable all-day health metrics such as steps, heart rate, sleep, and stress to create compelling applications in the markets of Corporate Wellness, Population Health, and Patient Monitoring.

claim: Five APIs: the Health API metric list includes steps, intensity minutes, sleep, calories and heart rate.
quote: Steps Intensity Minutes Sleep Calories Heart Rate

claim: Five APIs: the Health API metric list includes stress, Pulse Ox, Body Battery, body composition, respiration, blood pressure and enhanced beat-to-beat interval.
quote: Stress Pulse Ox Body Battery Body Composition Respiration Blood Pressure *Enhanced Beat-To-Beat Interval *

claim: Five APIs / delivery: the asterisk reads Supported with Enterprise Access only.
quote: Supported with Enterprise Access only

claim: Five APIs: the Activity API covers detailed fitness data captured during an activity.
quote: The Activity API provides access to the detailed fitness data captured during an activity on the user's wearable device or cycling computer.

claim: Five APIs: the Activity API page names running, cycling, swimming, yoga and strength training.
quote: Running Cycling Swimming Yoga Strength Training Activity Details

claim: Five APIs: activity files come in FIT, GPX and TCX formats.
quote: Full Activity Details Access: Activity data files (.FIT, GPX, .TCX formats) available for complete activity details

claim: Five APIs: the Activity API offers JSON summaries or FIT files.
quote: The Activity API offers access to JSON summaries or FIT files .

claim: Five APIs: the Women's Health API covers menstrual cycle and pregnancy tracking, including schedules and pregnancy details.
quote: The Garmin Connect Women's Health API provides information captured in Menstrual Cycle Tracking and Pregnancy Tracking, including schedules and pregnancy details.

claim: Five APIs: the Training API publishes workouts and training plans to the Garmin Connect calendar.
quote: The Training API allows you to publish workouts and training plans to the Garmin Connect calendar.

claim: Five APIs: published training data is available for users to sync with compatible devices.
quote: Once published, the training data will be available for users to sync with their compatible Garmin devices.

claim: Five APIs: the Courses API publishes courses to Garmin Connect.
quote: Similar to the Training API, Courses API allows you to publish courses to Garmin Connect.

claim: Five APIs: users follow courses from the standard Courses menu.
quote: Users can start following a course on their wearable or cycling computer from the standard Courses menu.

claim: Five APIs: new devices are supported automatically.
quote: Yes, new devices are supported automatically.

claim: Five APIs: Garmin tries to add new data types as devices launch but cannot always offer every metric.
quote: makes every effort to ensure new data types are available as new devices launch, however it's not always possible to offer every metric.

claim: Auth / FAQ: all APIs in the Developer Program use OAuth 2.0.
quote: All APIs in the Developer Program use OAUTH 2.0.

claim: Delivery / FAQ: Health API offers push or ping/pull, with ping/pull marked Enterprise-only.
quote: Push or *Ping/Pull Architecture: Choose the integration option that best matches your needs

claim: Delivery: Women's Health API offers push or ping/pull, with ping/pull marked Enterprise-only.
quote: Push or *Ping/Pull Architecture: Choose the integration option that best matches your needs

claim: Delivery / FAQ: customized data feeds, only subscribe to the data you need.
quote: Customized Data Feeds: Only subscribe to the data you need

claim: Delivery: multi-project support, marked Enterprise-only.
quote: *Multi-Project Support: Create and configure your apps independently from each other

claim: Delivery / steps: developer web tools, with backfill marked Enterprise-only, and auto-verification before production.
quote: Developer Web Tools: Easy on-boarding, sample data, *backfill user data, and auto-verification of your integration before production

claim: Delivery / FAQ: after consent, users sync their device with Garmin Connect, at which point data is accessible via the API.
quote: After initial consent, end-users sync their device with Garmin Connect to upload device data, at which point it is accessible via the API.

claim: Delivery: the Health API delivers JSON summaries including detailed stress, Pulse Ox and epoch summaries.
quote: Data includes heart rate, steps, calories, sleep, respiration, body composition as well as detailed stress, pulse-ox, and epoch summaries for all-day activities.

claim: Delivery: for Training and Courses, users consent, Garmin Connect handles the device side, and the user syncs.
quote: After providing consent, users can send your training data to Garmin Connect. Garmin Connect handles the interactions with the device. All the user needs to do is sync their device with Garmin Connect to download the data to their wearable or cycling computer.

claim: Fees / steps: to offer Garmin wearables, request the program and use the inquiry form.
quote: If you want to enhance your project by offering Garmin wearables, request the Garmin Connect Developer Program and contact us using the inquiry form with more information about your project.

claim: Intro / what changed / FAQ: personal-use questions go to the Personal API.
quote: Please visit the Garmin Connect Personal API for more information.

claim: Gotchas: the Personal API is not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.
quote: It is not intended for commercial applications serving multiple end users.

claim: FAQ, personal project: you create the personal key yourself on Garmin Connect Web.
quote: Go to the Personal API Key page while logged in to your Garmin Connect Web account
